findings.issue: `ContMDiffMul.boundarylessManifold` is stated only at `n = 1`, strictly weaker than `ContMDiffMul.isInteriorPoint` (any `n ≠ 0`) that proves it. Mathlib registers `ContMDiffMul I m G → ContMDiffMul I 1 G` only for `m ∈ {2, ∞, ω}` (Monoid.lean:88-103), and `minSmoothness` is `irreducible_def` (FDeriv/Symmetric.lean:492), so for the C³ consumers named in the PR — e.g. `[LieGroup I (minSmoothness ℝ 3) G]` at Exponential/Derivative/Basic.lean:47 — instance search cannot produce `ContMDiffMul I 1 G` and the docstring's `attribute [local instance] ContMDiffMul.boundarylessManifold` recipe fails; users must insert an extra `ContMDiffMul.of_le`.

summary: The packaging theorem is fixed at n = 1 while its proof and Mathlib's sibling lemmas support any n ≠ 0, so the C³ consumers the PR cites cannot use it via the documented local-instance recipe. Generalize the statement.
